paper.title: INCB054828 (pemigatinib), a potent and selective inhibitor of fibroblast growth factor receptors 1, 2, and 3, displays activity against genetically defined tumor models.

included: direct biochemical and cellular FGFR target-engagement IC50 endpoints
Table 1 72-hour CellTiter-Glo GI50 endpoints for FGFR-altered cell lines
one in-vivo KATO III pFGFR2 exposure-response IC50, explicitly marked as requiring PK coupling
excluded: Fig. 2 2-hour Western blots: lane concentrations are available but no densitometry, numerical uncertainty, or replicate count is reported; no band-intensity values were invented
Fig. 2C proximity-ligation images: qualitative images without a numerical readout
xenograft growth curves and serum phosphate: outside the current intracellular signaling-calibration scope

protocols.cellular_target_engagement: Genetically FGFR-activated cell context -> no exogenous ligand stated -> pemigatinib concentration series -> 2 h exposure for Fig. 2 immunoblots; S3 assay durations not reported -> pFGFR/pERK/pSTAT5/pFRS2 or pFGFR ELISA/assay measurement.
protocols.viability: FGFR-altered cell line -> 0.1% DMSO control or pemigatinib serial dilution -> 72 h incubation -> CellTiter-Glo ATP readout, expressed relative to control and summarized as GI50.
protocols.in_vivo_target_engagement: KATO III FGFR2-amplified xenograft -> single oral pemigatinib administration -> plasma and tumor harvested at unspecified sample times -> tumor-homogenate pFGFR2 ELISA versus plasma exposure.

supplement_provenance.retrieved_only_for_missing_target_specif: S3 Fig (PLOS supplementary file s008; official PLOS URL queried 2026-09-03)
supplement_provenance.used_information: S3 Fig legend confirms n=10 KATO III assays, n=11 KATO III-in-blood experiments, and n=3 each for Ba/F3 FGFR1-TEL and FGFR3-TEL. Main-text IC50 values were retained without digitizing the curves.

missing_or_partial: Generic ligand-driven FGFR is not isoform-specific FGFR1/2/3 and has no amplification, fusion, or activating-mutation overlay
No FRS2 state or pFRS2 observation
context_requirements_before_any_fit: Set PDGF, EGF, VEGF, IGF1, HGF, FLT3 ligand, cytokine inputs, and endothelial-only default stimulation to zero unless the selected cell context documents them.
Do not add exogenous FGF2 for these fusion/amplification contexts unless the chosen experimental condition specifies it.
Represent the selected FGFR alteration as a context overlay before comparing baseline or drug-treated signaling.

observation_mapping.mapping: proportional normalized phosphosignal; control normalization model(C)/model(control)

minimum_addition_before_fitting: A reusable FGFR1/2/3 receptor/context layer with alteration overlays (amplification, fusion, activating mutation) and an FGFR activity drug-inhibition interface for pemigatinib. Include FGFR-to-STAT5 only if the KG1a pSTAT5 blot is selected as a fit target. A phenotype mapping is separately required before using GI50 values.
